get_random_quotes.description: Get one or more random quotes from Ron Swanson of Parks and Recreation, all different, such as 'Never half-ass two things. Whole-ass one thing.' Good for a daily quote in a team channel. No API key required.

mock_response.quote: Never half-ass two things. Whole-ass one thing.
quotes: Never half-ass two things. Whole-ass one thing.
Honor: if you need it defined, you don't have it.

get_random_quotes.name: get_random_quotes

parameters.description: How many different quotes to get, 1 to 100. Defaults to 1.
parameters.name: count

count.description: How many quotes came back. Usually the number asked for; fewer only when more were asked for than the API holds.

quote.description: The first quote picked, for the usual case of wanting just one.

quotes.description: Every quote picked, all different, in random order.

search_quotes.description: Find every Ron Swanson quote that contains a word or phrase, ignoring case, such as 'bacon' or 'government'. Nothing matching comes back with 'found' set to false rather than failing the step. No API key required.

mock_response.first_quote: Just give me all the bacon and eggs you have. Wait...wait. I worry what you just heard was: Give me a lot of bacon and eggs. What I said was: Give me all the bacon and eggs you have. Do you understand?
quotes: Just give me all the bacon and eggs you have. Wait...wait. I worry what you just heard was: Give me a lot of bacon and eggs. What I said was: Give me all the bacon and eggs you have. Do you understand?

search_quotes.name: search_quotes

parameters.description: The word or phrase the quote must contain. Case does not matter, and it is matched exactly as typed.
parameters.name: term

count.description: How many quotes contain the text.

first_quote.description: The first matching quote, or empty when none matched.

found.description: True when at least one quote contains the text.

quotes.description: Every quote that contains the text, ignoring case.

term.description: The text that was searched for, tidied up.

description: Get random quotes from Ron Swanson of Parks and Recreation, or find the ones that mention a word, from the open-source Ron Swanson Quotes API. Good for a daily quote in a team channel. No account or API key required.
